labeling: Labels are synthetic rule-based scenario classes, not human preference, hiring outcome, or independent job-quality judgments. Labels deliberately distinguish evidence completeness and include three explicit metric edge cases. FSP demo evidence was assigned by a seeded stratified procedure across existing label classes, independently of labels. AI review is pending.

label_schema.0: Explicit hard incompatible, hidden, or unverified email; hard exclusions are zero.
label_schema.1: Required evidence, verified category, or a hard work condition is unknown; includes a declared-only required skill.
label_schema.2: Synthetic relevant fit with confirmed target category and all required test-evidence skills plus only part of test-assessable preferred evidence.
label_schema.3: Synthetic relevant fit with confirmed target category and all test-assessable preferred evidence.

split_method: First six needs are development; last six are holdout. Candidate UUID sets are disjoint across splits. Each need has 20 unique candidate IDs and unique synthetic template instance strings.

metric_protocol.p_at_3: Count relevant labels >=2 in the first 3 production-eligible results and divide by exactly 3; missing positions are padded with zero. A need with no eligible results has P@3=0.
metric_protocol.ndcg_at_5: Eligible ranking only; gain=2^label-1, discount=log2(rank+1), IDCG uses eligible judged labels for that need. If IDCG=0, report null and exclude that need from NDCG macro denominator.
metric_protocol.hard_errors: Assert no returned candidate has an explicit production hard-incompatibility; aggregate count must be zero.
metric_protocol.macro: Report arithmetic macro mean per need then split; include P@3 for every need, omit NDCG nulls from the mean, and report each denominator.
metric_protocol.empty_lists: Report total eligible-list empty count and production confirmed-group empty count separately. The all-hard-empty need has zero eligible results, P@3=0 and NDCG@5=null (IDCG=0). The unassessed-required PostgreSQL need has eligible label-1 profiles, P@3=0, NDCG@5=1.0 (gain=1 at every eligible rank), and an empty confirmed group only; it is not an empty result list. The two-positive need has exactly two eligible labels>=2 and fixed-denominator P@3=2/3.
